description: Take a VPS snapshot before a customer-approved risky change, such as an upgrade, migration or configuration change, so a later rollback has a restore point. A snapshot does not replace an independent backup. Requires manage scope.

description.description: Optional note about why the snapshot was taken.

name.description: Short snapshot name, e.g. before-php84. Letters, digits and dashes are the safe set.

name: impreza_vps_create_snapshot
title: Take VPS snapshot
